numeric_method.parameter_projection: Every supplied numerical problem/time parameter is converted to float64, then Decimal.from_float preserves that exact represented input. JSON decimal literals are not treated as more exact physical coefficients.

constants.interpretation: Exact declared SI decimals, matching the core's declared energy reference. Operational float rounding remains a possible refinement floor.

numeric_method.thermal_relation: T(N)=(T0+A)exp[2kB(N-N0)/C_A]-A; A=(D+I)/(2kB). A stable expm1 series avoids loss in weak release.
numeric_method.time_map: s=-ln(N/N0); t(s)=integral0^s exp[Ea(N0exp(-v))/(kB*T(v))]/nu dv. Decimal Gauss-Legendre nodes and weights are generated at each selected precision; binary cosine only seeds root Newton iterations.
numeric_method.inverse: Safeguarded Newton on the strictly monotone positive time map, bracketed by the initial per-parent hazard for alpha>=0, with declared positive thermal-domain support. Final-time inverse once per distinct case and precision/order; zero barrier uses exacts=nu*t.
numeric_method.translation: Independent positive quadrature of2kB*T over released inventory checks the analytic primitive; all channel relations are checked at all saved N values.
numeric_method.refinement: The nonlinear8/16/32/64 saved trajectory family is reused. Self-order uses three successive final values; no finite-reference error-ratio substitution.
numeric_method.scales: Coverage errors use emitted inventory, temperature uses final temperature drop, energies use their own final reference channel/debit. The bound-reservoir baseline is scaled by its removal change. Exactly zero channels require exactly zero error; no invented denominator.
